title: Recursive Lean physics pathology repair loop
summary: Monitor FormalScience pathologies, detect physics objects, work through MathformerPhysicsLib first, generate guarded repairs, map exhaustive expansion, and control recursion.

visible_workflows.description: Repair Lean physics pathologies through library-first object work and recursive evidence gates.

composed_skills.role: Detect taxonomy pathologies in Lean physics artifacts.
Identify physics mathematical objects behind pathology findings.
Plan MathformerPhysicsLib-first work over detected objects.
Generate guarded repair probes that remain advisory until checked.
Map the exhaustive recursive repair expansion.
Decide whether to recurse, complete, or block from the expansion map.

generated_skills.promotion_boundary: Repair probes must stay task-local unless repeated-use lifecycle evidence passes.

release_boundaries.rule: Target theorem refinement is blocked until MathformerPhysicsLib support objects are accepted or explicitly blocked.
Each recursion decision must cite expansion-map coverage and outstanding nodes.

risk_controls.risk: Recursive loop expands without a stopping policy.
risk_controls.control: Recursive controller records iteration signature, maximum iterations, blockers, and next actions.

risk_controls.risk: Generative repair edits accepted code without deterministic confirmation.
risk_controls.control: Generative repair plans remain advisory and must name rerun gates.
